English: Tinker Shed
A makeshift shelter of tarps and wood, where itinerant tinkerers mend tools and weapons. Provides essential repairs for the earliest days of settlement.
Craftsmans Hut
A simple log structure where skilled craftsmen gather to repair arms, armor, and common tools, improving the castles basic readiness.
Carpenters Shop
A sturdier timber-framed shop, where carpenters fashion defensive works and siege equipment, enhancing the military utility of the castle.
Masons Yard
A bustling open yard with stonecutters and masons at work, producing quarried stone for fortifications and advanced defenses.
Artisan Hall
A grand hall that attracts renowned artisans, improving the castles repute, defensive works, and overall prosperity through their collective skill.
Smiths Forge
A large stone forge and smithy, with apprentices and journeymen producing arms, armor, and vital tools for war and siege.
Guild Workshop
A well-established guildhouse, uniting specialized workshops under one roof. The guild brings efficiency, innovation, and prestige to the fortress.
Engineer Atelier
A renowned atelier staffed by military engineers, inventors, and architects, producing siege engines, complex defenses, and innovations that secure the realms future.
Toolmaker Workshop
A robust workshop employing skilled toolmakers, producing advanced equipment that increases efficiency across castle and army operations.
Masters Workshop
A prestigious workshop overseen by master craftsmen whose advanced techniques and inventions grant the castle unmatched defensive and economic strength.
